dedupe_keys.name: designsafe recon portal natural hazard event reconnaissance datasets map

description: The Recon Portal of DesignSafe, the cyberinfrastructure of the NSF Natural Hazards Engineering Research Infrastructure (NHERI), is an interactive world map of natural hazard events with the reconnaissance datasets associated with each event. A user selects an event by clicking a marker on the map, browsing the event list or searching it, and then sees the available datasets. Datasets may be hosted in DesignSafe or may be links to other datasets on the web. New events are added, and new datasets are attached to an existing event, on request through a DesignSafe help ticket. Access to the map is free and public; each linked dataset carries its own licence, and no single licence is stated for the portal. Caveats: the portal is an index, so coverage, formats and quality depend on the teams that contributed each dataset, and the map itself is rendered by scripts. Coverage is worldwide, with events such as earthquakes, hurricanes, floods and tsunamis. It supports hazard exposure and damage analysis of buildings and infrastructure after real events, and the calibration of fragility models; there are no related records in the catalogue yet on this branch, although it complements other event reconnaissance collections.
